data.name: Rufino
data.gender_notes: Rufino is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rufino is derived from the Latin word 'rufus,' which means 'red.' In Christian tradition, Saint Rufino is a third-century martyr who was a bishop of Tarragona in Spain. He was known for his red hair and his dedication to spreading the faith. The name Rufino carries the meaning “Red” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Rufino usually hope their child will grow to embody red and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the passion and courage of a faithful follower of Christ.
data.etymology: Rufino belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Red.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rufino total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: רופינו
in_hebrew.meaning: רופינו נגזר מהמילה הלטינית שפירושה אדום או ג׳ינג׳י
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רופינו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית, שם שפירושו אדום או ג׳ינג׳י, צבע שמסמל תשוקה, אנרגיה וחיים. השם קשור לסמליות של הלהבה ושל הדם, המייצגים את הדבקות והאהבה לאלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בעיקר במסורת הנוצרית הקתולית והאורתודוקסית, ומוענק לילדים שנולדים עם שיער אדמוני או בעלי אישיות תוססת.

in_greek.name: Ρουφίνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Ρουφίνο είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό Rufinus, που σημαίνει κόκκινος ή κοκκινομάλλης. Το όνομα συνδέεται με τη χριστιανική παράδοση και συμβολίζει το πνεύμα, τη θέρμη και την αγάπη. Στην αρχαία Εκκλησία, το όνομα Rufinus ήταν δημοφιλές ανάμεσα στους Χριστιανούς, καθώς συμβόλιζε την πνευματική φωτιά και την πίστη.

in_latin.name: Rufino
in_latin.meaning: Rufino significat rufus, id est, ruber, vel igneus
in_latin.long_meaning: Rufino est nomen christianum quod originem ducit a latino vocabulo 'rufus', quod significat ruber, igneus, vel rubellus. Nomen hoc symbolum est passionis, fervoris et devotionis ad Deum. In primitiva Ecclesia, nomen Rufinus frequenter dabatur fidelibus qui insignem devotionem et ardorem in fide demonstrabant.

in_english.name: Rufino
in_english.meaning: Rufino means red-haired or ruddy, symbolizing passion and energy
in_english.long_meaning: Rufino is a Christian name derived from the Latin word 'rufus,' meaning red-haired or ruddy. The name symbolizes passion, energy, and devotion, reflecting the fiery spirit of faith. Historically, Rufino has been used in Catholic and Orthodox traditions, often given to children born with red hair or those with lively personalities. The name holds spiritual significance, representing the inner fire of faith and commitment to one's beliefs.

The name is associated with Saint Rufino's red hair, which symbolizes the fiery passion and commitment to the faith that can burn bright even in the darkest of times. It is a name that inspires us to honor our spiritual heritage and to live our lives as examples of faith and devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rufino, meaning "red" in Latin, symbolizes the fiery spirit of faith and the deep red color of Christ's blood, shed for humanity's salvation. Spiritually, it represents the inner strength and fortitude that comes from a deep, unwavering faith.
